title: Kuraqpa Mana Suyasqa Mikhuynin
intro: Allahpa Wasinpa sagrado precintokunapin Diospa huk kuraq kamachin huk ukhu pakasqa yachayta rikurqan, chaymi llapa suyakuykunata mana kasurqanchu. Kay devoto sapan runa, unayña pasarqon natural tayta-mama kay watakuna, testigo karqan imapas extraordinario, chaymi rikuchirqan Divinoq mana tukukuq khuyapayakuyninta. Chay puzzleqa kashan kay qonqasqa momentota profetakunaq kawsayninmanta sut’inchaypin.
clues: Llaqtayqa Israel sutiwanmi reqsisqa karqan, ñawpa tiempopi hatun tayta-mamaq miraynin.
Tutaykunataqa mañakuypin pasarqani, yupaychana wasipi Señorniypa ñawpaqenpi qonqorikuspay.
Yuyaq kasqaypin huk qhari wawata qowarqanku, chay regaloqa manan hayk’aqpas saqerqanichu Allahta hatunchayta.
Pruebayqa karqan huk sustentota tarisqaymi, chaymi rikhurimurqan cuidasqay wayna almapaq.
Ñuqaqa Zakariyya sutiyuq profeta karqani, Bayt al-Maqdis nisqapi Maryamta cuidanaypaq encargasqa.
Kutichiyninqa kachkan chay versiculopim, chaypim Allah Maryamta chaskirqa hinaspam mikuykunata quykurqa.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
